channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Fighting in northern Ethiopia spurs fears of blackout and blockade
item.description: Tigray was cut off from the world during the 2020-2022 civil war, which killed around 600,000 people.

item.title: Pakistan, Turkiye edge closer towards joining Saudi war against Houthis
item.description: Pakistani and Turkish military chiefs head to Riyadh for urgent talks, but both countries remain cautious on involvement

item.title: UN General Assembly live: Leaders from Lebanon, Iraq, Pakistan to speak
item.description: The US-Israel war on Iran will continue to be a focus as the UNGA enters its fourth day.

item.title: What’s in Iran’s seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: Tehran’s offer comes as high fuel prices put pressure on Trump ahead of the US midterm elections.

item.title: Rising malnutrition in Nigeria as US war on Iran raises food costs
item.description: The war on Iran is raising the cost of living in Nigeria.

item.title: Iran pitches seven-day roadmap to end conflict with US
item.description: Tehran seeks rapid implementation failed ceasefire deal, offering to open Hormuz if regional conflicts halted.

item.title: Saudi Arabia allies line up support as Houthi attacks mount
item.description: France is sending military to protect key Yanbu oil terminal; Pakistan and Turkiye to hold military talks with Riyadh.

item.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
item.description: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

item.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
item.description: Pakistan says it struck 10 targets, adding the strikes were "strictly limited to identified military objectives".

item.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
item.description: A male suspect from Ukraine was arrested after the stabbings in the town of Jarosław, police say.
